card.name: Inside Malay words in one essay
card.fires_on: Pieces inside or at the start of Malay words (e.g. dalam, membawa, maklumat, penumpuan, sekolah) in a Malay-language passage about missionaries and Malaysia in 1869.

modes.label: Short Malay word starts
modes.description: The marked piece is a whole short Malay word or the start of one, such as Dalam.
modes.example: Filipina D<<alam>> tulisannya Rev John Russell menyif

modes.label: Middle of Malay words
modes.description: The marked piece sits partway through a longer Malay word like maklumat or membawa.
modes.example: Ini memb<<awa>> erti bahawa semua kepualaun

card.plain: It lights up on pieces of Malay words in one old-mission-history passage, with no clear meaning.
